title: Pan-Seared Kushikatsu with Cabbage Slaw
description: A Thai-inspired twist on the Japanese classic, kushikatsu, featuring crispy fried breaded pork cutlets served with a refreshing cabbage slaw.
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Dredge pork cutlets in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip floured pork cutlets in beaten eggs, then coat with japanese breadcrumbs.
Fry breaded pork cutlets until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a separate pan, heat kushikatsu sauce over medium heat.
Assemble kushikatsu by placing a fried pork cutlet on a plate, then spooning kushikatsu sauce over the top.
Serve immediately with shredded cabbage slaw on the side.
To make slaw, combine shredded cabbage, 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, and 1 tablespoon kushikatsu sauce in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
